messages:
alex: Quick thread to lock down customer-facing follow-ups from the postmortem. We need: status page copy, short customer digest, RCA access flow, and owner+due for each. Keep replies short.
elaine: I will draft the status page and the 72h digest. Target: status copy by Thu EOD, 72h digest Fri AM.
raj: I'll own the remediation tracker updates and add a short 'recurrence evidence' section with links to perf graphs. ETA: Tue AM.
maria: Legal prefers the following public stance: publish a concise summary + commit to an RCA within 7 business days. Full internal RCA available on request under a data-sharing addendum for enterprise accounts. I'll paste approved wording into the postmortem doc.
oliver: I'll prepare two outreach templates: 1) top-accounts (personalized + offer call) 2) broad broadcast. Wait for final status copy for tone.
support-bot: Support flow reminder: customer -> support@ -> auto-ticket -> tag incident-rca -> PSA routes to comms.
sam: Add a fallback sentence to the status page noting we applied fallbacks/rollbacks to reduce impact.
elaine: Draft status page (WIP):
``
Incident: intermittent inference errors affecting a subset of customers.
Impact: some customers experienced delayed or failed responses between 10:03:47 UTC.
Status: mitigated; fallback paths used during the window.
Next steps: investigation ongoing; an RCA will be published within 7 business days. Customers may request additional details via support@redwood.ai.
```
raj: Small edit: use "subset of customers" (good), and add line referencing KV cache as an area of investigation.
elaine: Added KV cache mention.
maria: Confirming legal-approved snippet: "We will publish a public RCA within 7 business days. Customers requesting the full internal RCA must execute our data-sharing addendum; contact support@ to begin this process."
oliver: Outreach plan: Top 5 accounts get a personalized note + offer a 30-min call. Others get broadcast + link to status page + offer to request details. Drafts Thu AM.
alex: Who will own the 24h internal technical summary? We want 24h internal to eng-sre/eng-runtime and 72h external to customers.
elaine: I can do both: 24h internal (Fri 9am) and 72h external (Fri noon). Sam will approve before send.
support-bot: Reminder set: status page review due in 36 hours.
raj: Tracker update preview: added "KV cache guardrails" item owner=@raj due=2026-04-09 verification=2-week regression tests. Logged two prior similar incidents for recurrence investigation.
maria: I'll attach the addendum template to the postmortem doc and include the simple request flow for support agents.
oliver: Once status copy is finalized I'll craft outreach notes. For top-tier I'll include the CTA for a walkthrough call.
sam: Approve flow: Elaine -> Sam -> Comms -> Send. Also, if RCA delivery slips, escalate to execs + notify impacted accounts.
aleX: (typo) alex: Typo fixed.
elaine: Final action recap: 1) Status page copy - elaine - Thu EOD. 2) 24h internal summary - elaine - Fri 9am. 3) 72h public digest - elaine - Fri noon (sam review). 4) Remediation tracker + recurrence notes - raj - Tue AM. 5) RCA sharing wording & addendum - maria - Wed EOB. 6) Top-5 outreach templates - oliver - Thu AM. 7) Support canned replies & flow - support team - Thu EOD. 8) Recurrence detection spike - raj - next sprint.
raj: Remediation tracker link uploaded: https://drive.redwood/trackers/remediation-1977001234
elaine: Draft status copy posted to #incidents-drafts and awaiting sam review.
maria: Legal sign-off confirmed; addendum attached in doc.
support-bot: Tasks created with due dates for owners.
alex: Thanks team. Ping me when drafts are in staging and I'll sanity-check before we hit send to customers.
